name: JBS N.V.
sector: Consumer Staples / Food — meat packing and protein processing
moat_justification: Scale and multi-protein, multi-geography diversification give real cost and resilience advantages, but this is commodity protein processing: gross margin only 10.9%-15.0% over FY2023-25, roic_proxy in fundamentals.json fell from 16.7% (FY2023) to 14.5% (FY2024) to 13.6% (FY2025), pricing is set by cattle/hog/chicken cycles and powerful retailers, and Q2 2026 showed the cycle can erase a quarter's profit. No durable pricing power or switching costs support a higher score.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

one_liner: Global protein scale, moat 4/10, but a commodity cyclical — weighted IRR 10.7% (Tier C, bear D to bull C) at $13.03 vs weighted IV@15% $8.36; clears 15% only below ~$8.36, with net debt 19.0x normalized OE.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: World's largest protein processor — scale in procurement, plant utilization and distribution across beef, pork, poultry and lamb
Multi-protein, multi-geography platform (US, Brazil, Australia, Europe) diversifies single-protein and single-country cycles
Branded and value-added businesses (Seara, Pilgrim's, Moy Park, Swift, Primo) sit above pure commodity slaughter
ROIC proxy stayed above cost of capital in all three filed years (16.7% / 14.5% / 13.6%, fundamentals.json)
moat_against: Commodity processing with thin gross margins (10.9%-15.0%) and no control over livestock input prices or meat cutout prices
Cattle-cycle exposure: tight US cattle supply drove a Q2 2026 net loss and an 18% YoY fall in adjusted EBITDA despite record sales
Powerful retail/foodservice buyers and low consumer switching costs limit pricing power
Leverage and governance: net debt $16.525B filed for FY2025, Q2 2026 leverage 3.1x, Batista family control, antitrust / food-safety / ESG exposure
